name: Lucien Bloodmarch
source:
Lucien is the son of [url=/c64149]Damien[/url]. The first time you see him, he is described as a 'low-rent Gerard Way'. Despite being a rebellious teenager, he seems to have a loving relationship with his dad, as seen in dialogue during the first date with Damien and at the [url=/c76975]player[/url]'s graduation party for [url=/c73297]Amanda[/url].

[From the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/Lucien]Wiki[/url].]
